author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
Fixes three findings from the security/design audit:

- **Forged assistant turns:** `POST /ask` accepted `role: "assistant"`, which was stored and replayed to the model as its own. It now accepts only `"user"` (422 otherwise).
- **Unbounded uploads:** `POST /documents` read the whole file into memory with no checks. It now refuses files over 10 MB (413) or not starting with `%PDF-` (415), before any turn is written or the model is called.
- **Unvalidated model output:** `parse_agent_reply` stored whatever the model sent. `message` must now be a non-empty string (otherwise the reply is shown as prose); `severity`, `confidence` and `ui` are dropped to `None` unless valid. Unhashable values no longer raise.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .`
- [x] `uv run pytest -q` (207 passed; new tests cover each fix, including 413/415 at the route)
- [ ] CI

Note: Starlette spools the multipart body before the handler runs, so the cap bounds what the agent and parser handle, not the temp-file write; a proxy body limit would cover that.
